description.en: Puts a player at a position of the main formation. The game keeps two lineups: the main formation (positions 1 to 11 for the players on the pitch) and a second lineup of 5 positions (probably the team for the small field matches).
Position number in the main formation.

true once set, false if the handle is 0.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Setting up a recruit (real usage, from ev42019001.nut)
